user_story: As a user, I want the system to handle an email with special characters correctly during registration so that valid edge-case emails are accepted.

positive.title: Register with a valid email containing special characters
steps: Enter a valid email with special characters (e.g., john.doe+test@example.com) into the email field.
Fill out the rest of the registration form correctly.
positive.expected_result: The registration is successful, and the user receives a confirmation message.

negative.title: Attempt registration with an invalid email containing special characters
steps: Enter an invalid email with improper special characters (e.g., john.doe.@.example..com) into the email field.
Fill out the rest of the registration form correctly.
negative.expected_result: The registration fails with an error message indicating the email is invalid.

edge.title: Register with a borderline valid email containing special edge-case characters
steps: Enter a borderline valid email with edge-case special characters (e.g., jane.o'williams+test@example.co.uk) into the email field.
Fill out the rest of the registration form correctly.
edge.expected_result: The registration is successful, and the user receives a confirmation message.
